title: Token emission slice markers and cached-prefix delta accounting
creator: Sofia Nguyen
description: Add low-overhead per-token emission slice markers and attribute KV-cache deltas to each token so that cost and latency dashboards can break down unit economics by token span, cache-hit vs cache-miss, and kernel wait times. This ticket covers the tracing hooks, runtime collectors, metrics aggregation, and dashboard queries for the initial rollout (hosted API + Dedicated).
background: Current telemetry aggregates at request and per-chunk levels which hides where cost accrues inside long emissions and across cached prefixes. Customers are asking for a per-token view to reconcile cost regressions and to validate cache policies. Prior work (ENG-33120, ENG-31999) provides token-level timing prototypes; this ticket designs a production-ready, low-overhead slice marker approach and ties it to cost delta accounting for KV cache hits.
proposed_solution: 1) Introduce lightweight span markers in the serving executor: emit_token_slice_start and emit_token_slice_end attached to token index and emission phase (decode/kernels/send). 2) Record a compact token timeline in ring-buffer per-inference; on request completion, produce an aggregated event with: token_index list (compressed ranges), per-token deltas (decode_ms,kernel_wait_ms,kv_fetch_ms,network_send_ms), and cache_hit bitmap. 3) Enrich traces with model.variant, batch_size, seq_len_prefix_cache_len, device_type, and kernel_version. 4) Export aggregated events to the metrics pipeline: Prometheus histograms (token_latency_ms), and a separate logs stream (JSON lines) for detailed per-request reconstructions. 5) Add dashboard panels and computed fields to map token latency to cost using the unit-cost model (gpu_cycle_factor * kernel_ms + memory_access_factor * kv_fetch_ms) and compute cache_savings per-request.
tradeoffs:
- Full per-token traces are expensive; we use an adaptive sampling policy: full capture for errors and P0 customers, 1% sampling for regular traffic, and size-based capture (requests with emission > 512 tokens).
- Ring-buffer reduces allocation overhead but requires careful synchronization; we favor per-executor preallocated buffers.
- Cost model approximates GPU cycles by kernel_ms which is noisy; plan to refine with kernel counters later (separate ticket).
implementation_notes:
- Instrumentation points: token_emit_begin(token_idx), token_emit_end(token_idx), kv_lookup(token_idx,prefix_len,hit_bool).
- Data format: compressed tokens list (ranges) + base64-encoded bitmap for cache_hit to avoid long logs.
- Use OpenTelemetry "events" on the parent span for lightweight capture; attach aggregated event at span end.
- Metrics: push per-token histograms to Prometheus via an aggregator that samples at the pod level and emits derived p50/p90/p99 per-model and per-route.
- Add a kafka/log stream topic 'token-timelines-v1' for detailed reconstructions and downstream cost batch jobs.
- Backwards compatibility: if runtime doesn't support this, fall back to existing chunk-level metrics.
testing_plan:
- Unit tests for ring-buffer correctness and compression/bitmap encode-decode parity.
- Load test (soak) on staging: measure overhead on p95 latency with sampling disabled/1%/10%. Goal: <3% median overhead and <8% p95 overhead in production config.
- Fault injection: simulate delayed kv backend to validate delta attribution.
- Integration: end-to-end trace + dashboard smoke tests using synthetic traces to ensure aggregation queries produce expected cost totals.
- Query validation against billing pipeline using a 24h sampled dataset.
rollout_plan:
1) Feature-flag gated launch in staging. 2) Beta for internal Redwood teams and 2 enterprise customers (opt-in) for 2 weeks. 3) Ramp to 10% of hosted traffic with sampling. 4) Full rollout and enable on Dedicated clusters with opt-out via config. 5) Post-rollout: collect telemetry on instrumentation overhead and false positives/negatives in cache attribution for 1 week.
- Rollback: disable feature flag and stop exporting token-timelines topic.
acceptance_criteria: Per-token aggregated event schema accepted and stored in token-timelines-v1 topic
Dashboards show token-level p50/p90/p99 and cache-hit vs miss breakdown by model and route
Overhead tests demonstrate <8% p95 latency overhead with default sampling in staging
Cost delta reports reconcile with sampled billing pipeline within 5% for test workloads
Documentation updated and SDK hooks available for Private deployments
